items.title: George Blanchin Interview, 1959-11-13
items.q: Did he sound anything like the records that Johnny put on?

ctx.x: Well, the next I heard of Snoozer was when I worked for the old Al Grunewald Music Company, and Snoozer came in occasionally to have his instrument repaired or maybe to get some strings and whatnot, and he'd sit back in a booth and play. And I thought he was a very wonderful musician.
Did he sound anything like the records that Johnny put on?
Yes, I would say so, yes.
